$comment: The digs ledger. This library is built by repeated excavation of our own history,
and the first dig is the easiest one — it is nowhere near all of it.
Every idea carries `source: <dig id>`. That makes 'what did this dig actually yield?'
a query instead of an archaeology project, and it keeps the library honest about
being incomplete: STATUS.md renders this as a board with the pending rows visible.
`yield` is written by scripts/build.mjs from the actual idea count — never by hand.

digs.label: Hand-written exemplars
digs.detail: The first ideas, written by hand to set the quality bar for everything after.

digs.label: Private project registry snapshot
digs.detail: A consolidated registry of ~98 projects assembled from session memories. Structured, so the cheapest dig to run first.

digs.label: Local project folders
digs.detail: ~90 working directories that never made it into the registry. Many are the same idea under a different name; dedupe against existing ids.

digs.label: Published repositories
digs.detail: Everything already public. Lowest scrub risk, highest link value — each one gets links.repo.

digs.label: Archive directory
digs.detail: Older work already set aside. Expect dead ideas, which are the most valuable kind here.

digs.label: Session transcripts
digs.detail: Ideas that were discussed, decided against, or tried in-session and never got a folder. The only source for `idea-only` entries. Highest scrub risk by far — transcripts contain everything.

digs.label: Published listings and actors
digs.detail: Things listed on somebody else's storefront, with real usage numbers attached.

digs.label: On-chain deployment history
digs.detail: Contracts and tokens deployed. Chain state is measurable evidence, so these entries can carry high-confidence verdicts.

digs.label: Outside contributions
digs.detail: Ideas and corrections contributed by people who are not us. Open-ended, permanently.
